title: A tested match of pack --root _self prints its pinned passage and little else
goal: pack --root _self QUESTION whose verdict is good (a tested question matched) prints the pinned passages, at most three further passages and the tied decisions, so a tested answer costs a fraction of the default budget; a weak pack keeps the full budget, since the agent must find the line itself; the report under kb/_self/reports/ records the bytes of a tested answer before and after
